tools.name: propbank_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a lemma and every alternate of it in PropBank (at most 20 per call).

language is "en" or "zh". Returns Markdown: per lemma, every roleset with its roles and all
its examples (the sentence, then each argument; traces such as *T*-1 are PropBank's own),
or "not in PropBank". Lemmas over the limit are not looked up: the last line names them
(call again with them). There is no PropBank for another language (Uzbek): nothing.

## Input

Language: en
Document: en-0008, sentence 3 of 9

The previous sentences (at most five; number, tab, words):

1	Edmund Pope tasted freedom today for the first time in more than eight months .

2	Pope is the American businessman who was convicted last week on spying charges and sentenced to 20 years in a Russian prison .

Their graphs:

I treated "for the first time in more than eight months" as an ordinal: first (value 1) within a range of "more than eight months".

# sentence level graph:
(s1t / taste-01

        :aspect state)
    :temporal (s1t2 / today)
    :ord (s1o / ordinal-entity
        :value 1
        :range (s1m / more-than
            :op1 (s1t3 / temporal-quantity
                :quant 8

    :aspect performance)

# ::snt 2
# sentence level graph:
(s2i / identity-91

        :name (s2n / name :op1 "Pope"))
    :ARG2 (s2b / businessman
        :mod (s2c / country
            :wiki "United_States"
            :name (s2n2 / name :op1 "America"))
        :ARG1-of (s2a / and
            :op1 (s2c2 / convict-01
                :ARG1 s2b

                    :ARG1 s2b

                    :mod (s2l / last))

            :op2 (s2s2 / sentence-01

                    :mod (s2c4 / country
                        :wiki "Russia"

                    :quant 20
                    :unit (s2y / year))

3	He denied any wrongdoing .

content.text:
# document level relations:
(d / document
    :temporal ((document-creation-time :before s3d)
               (s3d :before s3d2))
    :modal ((root :modal author)
            (author :full-affirmative s3p)
            (s3p :full-affirmative s3d)
            (s3d :unspecified s3d2))
    :coref ((s2p :same-entity s3p)))

This sentence is the same one the guidelines use as their worked example, so I followed that example's choices:

- **Temporal:** The denial happened in the past, so it comes before the document creation time. The wrongdoing being denied would come before the denial.
- **Modal:** The author asserts the person, and the person asserts the denial. The wrongdoing is marked `unspecified` under the denial, as in the example. I didn't use `full-negative`, even though "deny" leans that way.
- **Coreference:** "He" is Pope, so it links to the closest earlier mention, `s2p` in sentence 2.

I left out `wrong-02` (`s3w`), which the guidelines' example also omits. Under a strict reading of "every event," it could arguably get its own temporal and modal parent.
